title: Maximum Length of a Concatenated String with Unique Characters
summary: Given an array of strings, determine the longest string that can be formed by concatenating a subsequence with all unique characters, maintaining the original order of elements.
statement: Given an array of strings, determine the longest string that can be formed by concatenating a subsequence with all unique characters, maintaining the original order of elements.
constraints: Choose a subsequence of strings and concatenate it in original order.
Every character in the result must be unique.
Return the maximum possible result length.
hints: Represent each internally unique word by a 26-bit mask.
Maintain masks reachable from processed words.
Combine a word only with masks sharing no set bit and maximize the bit count.
Disjoint masks correspond exactly to concatenations with globally unique characters.
editorial: Disjoint masks correspond exactly to concatenations with globally unique characters.

tests.explanation: Choosing iq and ue gives four distinct characters.
Concatenating cha, r, and ers gives six distinct characters.
